findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 3, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - successive client sign-off reviews omit an unresolved finding.
The repair restriction added here only changes saved known-findings accounting. The sign-off path still calls `review._settled`, whose unchanged implementation at src/forge/review.py:612–613 labels any earlier finding omitted from a later review `fixed: absent from a later review`. That label reaches subsequent sign-off prompts through src/forge/records.py:555, and src/forge/review.py:977–978 filters the finding out even if a reviewer reports it again. Thus an omission still becomes a claimed repair and can suppress an unresolved blocker. Apply the repair-evidence rule to this settlement path too. The new test seeds `known` directly and exercises `forge close`, so it does not cover this actual sign-off sequence.
